groups.label: Age structure
groups.description: Younger to older authored head proportions. This is not age in years or a prediction of individual ageing.

groups.label: Head width
groups.description: Narrower to wider head proportions.

groups.label: Head height
groups.description: Shorter to taller head proportions.

groups.label: Face fullness
groups.description: Less to more facial fullness. This is a facial shape choice, not body weight or body fat percentage.

groups.label: Cheek prominence
groups.description: Change both cheek regions together while retaining their differences.

groups.label: Eye size
groups.description: Change both eye regions together while retaining their differences.

groups.label: Eye spacing
groups.description: Bring the eye regions inward or outward, retaining any asymmetric placement.

groups.label: Nose size
groups.description: Change the authored width, height and depth coordinates together, retaining their relative detail.

groups.label: Lip fullness
groups.description: Change upper and lower lip volume together, retaining their difference.

groups.label: Mouth width
groups.description: Narrower to wider mouth proportions.

groups.label: Chin projection
groups.description: Move the authored chin form backward or forward.

groups.label: Jaw width
groups.description: Change the authored lower-face bony width.

groups.label: Ear size
groups.description: Change both ears together while retaining their differences.

groups.label: Under-eye fullness
groups.description: Change both under-eye regions together while retaining their differences.

groups.label: Facial dimorphism
groups.description: Change the source dimorphism field. This is an authored facial shape axis, not a person's sex or gender.

groups.label: Overall facial fullness
groups.description: Change the shared adiposity shape field across the face. It does not specify body weight or fat percentage.

groups.label: Facial definition
groups.description: Change the source muscularity shape field across the face. This does not estimate muscle mass or physical fitness.

groups.label: Cheek height
groups.description: Lower or raise both cheek regions, preserving their difference.

groups.label: Eye opening at rest
groups.description: Change the central, medial and lateral aperture-height fields together, preserving asymmetry and regional detail.

groups.label: Outer eye-corner height
groups.description: Lower or raise both outer corners while retaining inner-corner placement and left/right differences.

groups.label: Upper eyelid-fold height
groups.description: Lower or raise both upper-lid folds, preserving their difference.

groups.label: Nose profile curve
groups.description: Move from the authored concave to convex nasal profile.

groups.label: Mouth corners at rest
groups.description: Lower or raise the corners at rest. A performed smile is controlled separately.

groups.label: Cupid's bow
groups.description: Change the definition of the central upper-lip bow.

groups.label: Brow height at rest
groups.description: Lower or raise the shared brow field before expression.

groups.label: Chin cleft
groups.description: Decrease or increase the central chin cleft.
